Bill's Candy ShopWilly Wonka & the Chocolate FactoryGolden ticket. Sugar high.Every recipe serves 4.

    StartersWhite chocolate teacups with creamWhite chocolate cups filled with vanilla whipped cream, with a chocolate handleHow to make it200g white chocolate200ml thickened cream2 tbsp icing sugar1 vanilla bean30g dark chocolateMelt the white chocolate and brush two coats inside small paper cups, setting between coats.Chill until firm, then peel off the paper.Whip the cream with the icing sugar and vanilla seeds and fill the cups.Pipe dark chocolate handles and stick them on. Eat the whole thing.Snozzberry crackersSeeded crackers with whipped ricotta and crushed raspberries, blackberries, blueberriesHow to make it100g raspberries100g blackberries100g blueberries1 tbsp caster sugar16 seeded crackers200g ricottaCrush the raspberries, blackberries and blueberries with the sugar using a spoon.Whip the ricotta until smooth.Spread on the crackers and top with the berries. Taste them and decide what a snozzberry is.Golden goose salted caramel eggsVeruca wants a goose that lays golden eggs for EasterHow to make itAs written, serves 4Dark chocolate egg shells filled with salted caramel ganache, joined and brushed with edible gold lustre until they shine like golden eggs.Melt 300g dark chocolate gently and brush into 16 half-egg moulds in two coats, chilling between, then set.Heat 80ml cream and pour over 100g chopped milk chocolate, then stir in 3 tbsp thick caramel and a pinch of sea salt and cool until thick.Fill the shells, warm the rims on a hot tray and press halves together.Chill, unmould and brush with edible gold lustre.MainsBucket house stewBeef shin, carrots, potatoes and pearl barley braised 3 hours, with breadHow to make it800g beef shin, diced2 brown onions3 carrots400g potatoes100g pearl barley1.2 L beef stock1 Italian loafBrown the beef in batches.Soften the onions, then add the carrots, potatoes, pearl barley and stock.Cover and braise at 160°C until thick and tender.Serve with slices of the Italian loaf to stretch it further.Chocolate room edible garden boardThe room where everything, even the grass, is edibleHow to make itAs written, serves 4A big board planted like a garden: toasted marshmallow mushrooms on pretzel stalks, chocolate strawberries, toffee apple wedges, honeycomb rocks and a fairy floss cloud.Melt 200g dark chocolate.Dip 250g strawberries halfway and set on baking paper.Push pretzel sticks into 12 large marshmallows, toast the tops with a blowtorch or under the grill and dip the bases in chocolate.Cut 2 apples into wedges, toss in lemon juice and drizzle with 3 tbsp warm caramel.Break 150g honeycomb into rocks.Arrange on a board with crushed chocolate biscuit soil and fairy floss in the middle.SweetsGobstopper trufflesCherries wrapped in white then dark ganache, rolled in cocoa and sprinklesHow to make it12 maraschino cherries150g white chocolate150g dark chocolate125ml thickened cream2 tbsp cocoa powder4 tbsp coloured sugarHeat part of the cream and pour over the white chocolate to make ganache.Chill until firm enough to handle.Wrap each drained cherry in white ganache and chill again.Heat the rest of the cream, pour over the dark chocolate and cool to a dark ganache.Wrap the white balls in dark ganache and chill.Roll in cocoa and coloured sugar. Bite to see the layers.DrinksFizzy lifting raspberry lemon sodaRaspberry and lemon with soda water and a scoop of lemon sorbetHow to make it150g raspberries2 lemons2 tbsp sugar syrup1 L soda water4 scoops of lemon sorbetBlitz the raspberries and strain.Mix with the lemon juice and sugar syrup and divide between four tall glasses.Top with very cold soda water and drop in a scoop of lemon sorbet so it fizzes up. Don't burp.
